name: [[785,8,27]] two-row local reduction of planar tile code

provenance.construction: From codes/786-8-27.json, XOR Z rows 126 and 148 to obtain the local weight-2 stabilizer support [548,568]. Replace Z row 126 by that combination, clear qubit 548 from every other Z check using the combination, then delete row 126 and qubit 548. Shorten X checks and remove coordinate 548, preserving the order of all other rows and qubits.
provenance.notes: A two-row local Z stabilizer shortens the published 786-qubit tile code while preserving k=8, weight 8, one-layer radius 4, and explicit X-27 and Z-27 logicals. Distance remains a witness-backed upper bound.
